annotations.title: Look up a public IP (RDAP + reverse DNS)

description: [PAID $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Given a public IPv4 or IPv6 address (default 1.1.1.1), returns the RDAP registration record from rdap.org (network name, handle, type, country, start/end, CIDRs, org when present) and the reverse DNS PTR via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS. Private, reserved and documentation ranges are rejected (400, not charged). This is not a city-level geolocation product and does not use a paid IP-intel vendor. Two outbound requests, 5 s RDAP / 4 s DNS timeouts. Missing RDAP with no PTR = 404; both sources down = 502; never charged on errors.

ip.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up (default 1.1.1.1). Private/reserved addresses are rejected.
